title: Explainable Artificial Intelligence for Customer Churn Prediction in Telecommunications: A Framework for CRM Integration
abstract: arXiv:2608.26151v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Subscriber attrition is a costly, persistent challenge for telecommunications providers, with monthly churn of roughly 1.9% in mature markets eroding billions in revenue annually. Predictive models can flag at-risk customers accurately, yet they are routinely excluded from frontline CRM workflows because high-performing ensemble and non-linear architectures are opaque: a retention specialist cannot design a personalised intervention from a probability score alone, without knowing why a subscriber is at risk. translated_title: 面向电信客户流失预测的可解释人工智能：一种CRM集成框架
translated_abstract: 用户流失是电信服务提供商面临的高成本、持续性的挑战，在成熟市场中，月流失率约为1.9%，每年侵蚀数十亿美元的收入。预测模型能够准确识别有风险的客户，但高性能的集成和非线性架构往往不透明，导致它们通常被排除在一线CRM工作流程之外：保留专员无法仅凭概率分数设计个性化干预措施，而不知道客户为何面临流失风险。本文旨在解决这一缺口。我们在IBM电信客户流失基准数据集（7,043条记录；19个特征；流失率26.5%，仅在训练集上通过SMOTE平衡至50%）上对四种分类器——逻辑回归、随机森林、XGBoost和LightGBM——进行了基准测试。逻辑回归取得了最强的AUC-ROC（0.8411），LightGBM的准确率最高（78.42%）；所有四种模型的AUC差距在0.011以内（0.831–0.841），并通过5折交叉验证。
tldr: 本文提出一个可解释人工智能框架，将多种预测模型集成到CRM工作流中，在保持高预测性能的同时提供客户流失原因的可解释性，以便一线人员设计个性化保留策略。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an explainable AI framework that integrates multiple predictive models into CRM workflows, maintaining high predictive performance while providing interpretability of churn reasons to enable frontline staff to design personalized retention strategies.
